newsitem.title: USA: Waterlink secures $40 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Waterlink secures $40 mln credit facility.

text.p: Waterlink Inc on Friday said it received a $40 million secured credit facility from a group led by Bank of America.

The water-purification and wastewater-treatment company, which made its initial public stock offering Wednesday, said it planned to use proceeds from the facility to fund its operations and pay for future acquisitions.
It said the facility would enable its subsidiaries outside the United States to secure $10 million of additional credit lines.
The IPO raised net proceeds of $43.8 million from the sale of 4.5 million common shares at $11 each, it said.
The company plans to use that money to repay debt and complete the acquisitions of Bioclear Technology Inc of Winnipeg, Manitoba, and Lanco Environmental Products Inc of Grand Rapids, Michigan.
